migrationNotes: Second HHH Core Case release, produced against the released Core Case 01 baseline b220461becc4fa7aadbbbabbb226aa0564c3c685 and the approved Blueprint.

Owner-approved printable content baseline: ea2eab2041a76c2f5d19d5d3b2c9d700af80a663. The owner reviewed that byte set on screen and printed it at 100% / Actual Size. Release conversion changed no printable source: content.html, presentation.css and layout-overrides.json are byte-identical to that commit, and only task-registry.js moved, to carry the lifecycle stamp, which renders nothing.
Frozen game-source baseline: d9fc16baf272cb543c29cbd0c06ec85efad60be8. Dossier cards A and B quote Level 2 at that commit. The Phase 1 audit baseline remains 9b8545ed6ecf98b337326390400076e36789e056.

Game dependencies at release: HHH-GAME-C1L2-001 is RESOLVED_VERIFIED at d9fc16b - the required clue reads 'without the old fallow rest.' and is quoted verbatim, with a browser assertion rejecting the truncated form. HHH-GAME-C1L2-002 is CURRICULUM_QUALIFICATION_REQUIRED and is delivered as mandatory curriculum treatment rather than a disclaimer. HHH-GAME-C1L2-003 remains open and nonblocking; the malformed scribe-record wording appears nowhere and a browser assertion prevents its reuse.
Runtime case identity: C1 L2, Sumer, the southern floodplain, about 2000 BCE. instructionalType CORE_CASE.

Nine tasks carry the Core Case spine, and the case's organising idea is scale rather than chronology: vocabulary, first reading, setting, the water-and-salt mechanism, what the crop change proves, evidence status, five claims of deliberately different sizes, a qualified causal explanation, and a transfer exit on an invented district.

Canonical CER is deliberately not used. A frame built for defending one position would push students toward the single-cause overclaim the audit required qualifying, because the honest answer to the region-scale dispute is that the packet's evidence does not decide it. Teacher page 4 states the rationale for classroom readers.

Scale boundary: the page-1 Reconstruction and scale notice names both questions the case asks and states which one the packet settles. Task 5 separates consistency from proof and supplies the rival explanation published in 1985. Task 6 row four separates a measurement from an inference drawn from it. Task 7 marks the single-cause claim N and the power-moved-north claim as undecidable by this case. Task 8's fourth required component is a claim pitched at the right strength. The four audit-rejected formulations are recorded in task-registry.js under scaleBoundary.prohibitedClaims and a browser assertion keeps them out of every role.

No ancient measurement appears in the packet. Every number is modern and sourced: two FAO crop salt-tolerance thresholds (barley 8.0 dS/m, wheat 6.0 dS/m), an FAO rainfall figure, a 565 km drain length, and dated FAO survey findings. The 1958 Jacobsen and Adams crop-shift study appears as a reading of records, never as a dataset, because its specific figures are precisely what the 1985 Powell critique disputes and they could not be verified from an accessible copy during production.

Source model: seven canonical caseSources entries, one per Teacher-ledger row, including the curriculum-original cross-section model registered at evidentiaryStatus 'modeled'. No source/evidence-ledger.json was created; the registered package schema is closed and the evidence model lives where Case 01 carries it.

Regression protection added with this case and retained by the release: registry-driven learner source-status parity against caseSources.evidentiaryStatus, a primary-source/eyewitness prohibition on every status line, load-bearing no-game fact availability in both learner editions, prohibited single-cause formulations read from the task registry, corrected-clue quotation with truncation rejection, salt-profile water-table geometry parsed from the rendered figure, tolerance-bar values checked against the registry, setting-figure label containment and collision measurement, and two cross-case guards in validate_static.py - task-registry-to-package role page counts, and printable prose that advertises a role page count.

The Task 3 setting figure was rebuilt after the owner gate opened. It was a four-band stack that read as a table: the Gulf and the marshes were rows rather than places, nothing showed water travelling anywhere, and the near-level ground Part C asks about was asserted only in words. It is now a schematic side view with one flow direction and one marked outlet. It still draws no coastline, no channel courses and no boundaries, because none are settled for this period; the extended description carries that disclaimer and states that the height is exaggerated and nothing is to scale.
This release claims no SSS legacy exemption. It is a full current-contract release with frozen Student, Teacher and Answer Key DOM baselines.
